حَظُولٌ : see حَظِلٌ. ―
-b2- Also A ewe, or she-goat, that limps, or is slightly lame, and changed in colour, in consequence of a tumour in her udder: (M, TA:) or a she-camel, and a ewe or she-goat, having her udder swollen, and her milk bad. (AHei, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
